description: This file is a shell script used for diagnosing and collecting bug reports related to hardware and kernel issues, specifically for the ath10k driver and OpenWrt system.

methods.name: bugcheck_generic
methods.description: Collects system information such as uname, os-release, dmesg, CPU info, memory info, and kernel command line to generate a crash report.

methods.name: roll_crashes
methods.description: Rotates existing crash reports by renaming current crash directory to preserve previous data before creating a new crash directory.
